patches.why: STRUCTURAL RECOVERY, read at the plate 2026-09-16 (prep spot check). Migne sets a display heading above this work and Corpus Corporum drops the whole line; our TEI body opened at CC's own catalogue title, which Migne does not print. Same class as the five Glossa Pentateuch book-title lines (Wilson's ruling 2026-09-06), encoded by the same convention: <head type="book-title"> above the first head, before the first column mark, so col is null. Witness: Gallica ark:/12148/bpt6k5505319w, map f = (column + 1) / 2 (corners read FIRST: f6 = 11/12, f13 = 25/26, f15 = 29/30, f17 = 33/34, f18 = 35/36); this heading on f13 (cols 25/26). Transcribed with ae for the ligature as the TEI does; Migne's capitals, small capitals and italics are not encoded. Read at native resolution from a server-side crop.

Word division, our split. archive patrologiaecurs04migngoog p.18 prints duodecimo fused mid-line; Gallica ark:/12148/bpt6k5505319w f13 (25/26) right column shows a worn hairline but no word space. No marker moves. Plate-read by stint B, 2026-09-16; corner numbers read FIRST on every leaf cited.

Dropped opening guillemet. Both printings (Gallica ark:/12148/bpt6k5505319w f15, corners 29/30, left column; archive patrologiaecurs04migngoog p.20) set « quinto : « Vidi in dextera sedentis; the first « is a line-start continuation mark, the second is the real opening of the Apoc 5:1 quotation, which the TEI dropped. The English gains the matching « in the same commit. Continuation marks are not patched (8957 ruling). Plate-read by stint B, 2026-09-16; corner numbers read FIRST on every leaf cited.
